jobs.title: Retail Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Retail Project Coordinator

**GoldUnion US – Beverly Hills**

GoldUnion, a global leader in buying and selling precious metals, is rapidly expanding across California, with a goal of opening **25 locations by 2027**. We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Retail Project Coordinator to support and oversee our retail expansion efforts across the state.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working on-site, solving practical problems, and being directly involved in getting retail spaces ready for business.

**Position Overview**

As part of GoldUnion’s retail expansion team, the Retail Project Coordinator plays a key role in managing and supporting the build-out and launch of new branch locations. This position is focused on project coordination, vendor management, timeline tracking, and ensuring operational readiness from planning through grand opening.

This is a field-based role with a home base in **Beverly Hills, CA**, requiring **frequent travel** between branch locations throughout California. A company vehicle will be provided.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and oversee multiple retail expansion projects from pre-construction through store opening
* Work closely with contractors, vendors, and internal teams to ensure projects stay on schedule and meet company standards
* Track project timelines, deliverables, and milestones, ensuring timely completion of all phases
* Conduct site visits and walkthroughs to monitor progress, identify issues, and ensure quality control
* Serve as a point of contact between operations, construction teams, and external partners
* Assist in resolving on-site challenges and ensuring projects move forward efficiently
* Support final setup and readiness of new locations prior to opening
* Ensure each branch meets operational, safety, and brand standards before launch
* Travel between locations as needed to support multiple active projects

**Candidate Profile**

* Previous experience in project coordination, facilities coordination, construction, or retail build-outs preferred
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
* Experience working with contractors, vendors, or cross-functional teams
* Able to follow instructions, coordinate with others, and communicate clearly with internal teams
* Flexible schedule and willing to travel extensively across California
* Experience in retail expansion or construction project environments is a plus
* Strong work ethic, positive attitude, and willingness to learn are essential

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Salary:** $55,000 per year
* Company car provided
* Gas and hotels fully covered during travel

**Working Hours**

* Full-time, Monday through Friday 10am-6pm
* Occasional weekends based on business needs and branch opening schedules

**Location**

* Office currently based in **Beverly Hills, CA**
* Frequent travel to branch sites throughout California required

**Recruitment Process**

* Initial phone or video interview
* In-person interview with the operations leadership team

**Required Notices (California & Federal):**

GoldUnion is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available as required by law.

GoldUnion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act. Background screenings and applicant information are handled in accordance with applicable laws.

The listed pay range reflects GoldUnion’s good-faith estimate for this position. Actual pay may vary based on lawful job-related factors. Commission and incentive earnings are performance-based and not guaranteed.

Offers of employment are contingent upon applicable lawful onboarding requirements and screenings.

Pay: $20.00 - $26.44 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience in project management in retail or construction?

Experience:

* Project management: 1 year (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 75% (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Construction Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

***Breakform Construction, Inc***. is a full-service architecture and design firm, General Contractor, and Metal Fabrication specialist, dedicated to creating spaces that seamlessly blend function, beauty, and craftsmanship.

Originating as a metal fabrication company, Breakform Construction is renowned for its meticulous attention to detail and its use of raw materials such as glass, metal, wood, concrete, and landscape to craft timeless, authentic designs. We are based in Los Angeles and are looking for local candidates who can commit to a hybrid schedule.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly organized Project Coordinator to serve as the operational backbone of our project management team. In this central role, you will work closely with Project Managers and site superintendents to keep day-to-day operations moving efficiently, safely, and within budget.  
The ideal candidate bridges the gap between the field office and the corporate office, translating high-level project strategy into organized task execution, strict document control, and clear stakeholder communication.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Document Control & Administration***

* Manage critical project files, including contracts, permit applications, change orders, submittals, Requests for Proposal (RFPs), and Requests for Information (RFIs).
* Review shop drawings and contract documents to ensure updates are properly distributed to subcontractors and field staff.
* Maintain accurate compliance logs, including subcontractor Certificates of Insurance (COI) and safety documentation.
* Compile operation and maintenance (O&M) manuals and as-built drawings for final project closeout.

***Scheduling & Logistics***

* Assist in creating and tracking comprehensive project timelines and milestones.
* Coordinate the scheduling of subcontractors, vendors, utility tie-ins, and site walkthroughs.
* Order materials, track delivery logistics, verify packing slips, and manage site access constraints.

***Communication & Financial Tracking***

* Act as a point of contact between clients, engineers, architects, subcontractors, and municipal agencies.
* Prepare and distribute daily or weekly project status and productivity reports.
* Organize, schedule, and take detailed notes during client progress meetings.
* Assist with project cost tracking, verification of pay applications, and invoice processing.
* Monitor project expenditures against the baseline budget to flag potential cost overruns.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in construction administration, project support, or general contracting operations.
* Proficiency with Bluebeam and Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel).
* Solid grasp of standard construction workflows, building codes, and documentation processes (RFIs, submittals, change orders).
* Exceptional organization and multitasking skills, with the ability to maintain accuracy under tight project deadlines.
* Strong professional verbal and written communication skills for working with diverse stakeholders.
* Proactive, collaborative problem-solver with an eye for identifying bottlenecks or safety non-conformance early.
* Ability to split time between the office and active job sites, wearing required PPE on site.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Five or more years of experience in construction administration, project support, or general contractin operations.
* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field (equivalent field experience may be substituted).
* Experience with Buildertrend.

**Job Details**

**Benefits**

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Retirement plan

**Schedule**

* 8-hour shift, Monday–Friday

**Experience**

* Construction administration / project support: 5 years (Preferred)
* Bluebeam: Required
* Buildertrend: Preferred

**Physical Requirements / Work Environment**

* N/A

Pay: $75,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* relevant work: 5 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Salesforce Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

The Salesforce Project Coordinator will help teams plan and execute the vision for our clients through transformative technologies to solve real-world business problems with sound business principles. This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. The Senior Project Manager will manage the end-to-end execution of projects with internal creative and development teams to deliver tangible value.  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
* Manage day-to-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables
* Maintain prompt, proactive, and transparent communication with the client to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to effectively drive project delivery
* Lead team and client meetings, ensuring timely follow-up and holding project team members accountable
* Provide daily task coordination, action tracking and project evaluation
* Leverage data to measure and monitor progress against commitments and provide transparency to project team
* Coach clients on Agile practices and champion the right Agile frameworks based on the type of work
* Use effective decision making to control risk and minimize uncertainty while being proactive through strategic thinking to strive to find new and innovative ways to deliver successful results
* Implement streamlined, effective processes through change management
* Mentor and train entry level team members; play a key role in the interviewing and onboarding process for new Project Managers
* Operate as an innovative thought leader; contribute significantly to the overall growth and quality of the department through knowledge sharing and coaching on current best practices and market trends

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in technology-focused project management
* Minimum of 1-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects
* Experience managing and forecasting budgets
* Ability to provide attention to detail and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
* Experience creating and maintaining a project plan from inception through completion
* Demonstrated success in leading multiple enterprise strategic projects from end-to-end
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to C-Level management
* Excellent organizational, multi-tasking, facilitation, and time management skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills; able to maintain solid rapport through the various working styles of team members as well as clients
* Ability to collaborate and apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills as required
* We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening.
* Bachelor’s degree

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in Agile, Project Management, or Business Process Management, highly preferred (or willingness to achieve identified certification within first 12 months of employment)
* Experience working with Salesforce, highly preferred

#hybrid

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.

The wage range for this role takes into account

jobs.title: Patient Outcome Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Kheir Clinic** is committed to providing culturally and linguistically-sensitive quality healthcare and human services to the underserved and uninsured residents of Los Angeles.

**Kheir Clinic** was established in 1986 to serve as a bridge between low-income, recently-immigrated, non-English speaking Korean community and local health and social service providers. Today, Kheir is a broad-based agency providing comprehensive health care for a diverse population through its 7 clinics (Federally Qualified Health Center sites), Adult Day Health Care Center and Patient Resources Department.

**MISSION:**

Kheir's mission is to increase and provide access to culturally and linguistically-sensitive quality primary healthcare and human services support to the underserved and uninsured residents of Southern California.

**ASSIGNMENT SUMMARY:**

The Patient Outcome Project Coordinator (POPC) supports the planning, coordination, and execution of both internally initiated and externally driven projects, while providing day-to-day administrative and organizational support to the Operations department. This role works closely with Operations leadership and cross-functional teams to keep projects organized, track timelines and deliverables, facilitate clear communication, and ensure operational priorities move forward efficiently and effectively.

The POPC is a key support role within the organization and is responsible for keeping project and operational details organized, maintaining accurate documentation, coordinating meetings and follow-ups, and helping teams stay aligned on priorities and deliverables. The POPM reports to the Associate Vice President of Operations,

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Project Coordination & Support:**

* Support assigned projects with the planning, coordination, and execution from initiation through completion.
* Maintain project timelines, task lists, status trackers, and other project documentation.
* Coordinate project meetings, including scheduling, agendas, meeting notes, action items, and follow-up.
* Track project deliverables, milestones, deadlines, and outstanding items to help keep projects on schedule.
* Follow up with internal teams and stakeholders regarding assigned tasks and deadlines.
* Help identify potential delays, gaps, or issues and escalate them to supervisor.
* Assist with preparing project updates, status reports, presentations, and other project-related materials.
* Maintain organized project files, documentation, and records.
* Help coordinate communication between departments and ensure relevant information is shared with the appropriate stakeholders.
* Support project closeout activities, including documentation, outstanding action items, and lessons learned.

**Operations Support:**

* Provide administrative and coordination support to the Operations department and Operations leadership.
* Assist with tracking operational priorities, tasks, deadlines, and initiatives.
* Maintain operational spreadsheets, trackers, reports, and documentation.
* Coordinate internal meetings, recurring operational check-ins, and follow-up activities.
* Help document and maintain standard operating procedures, processes, and workflows.
* Support the implementation and ongoing maintenance of operational processes and systems.
* Assist with collecting, organizing, and reporting operational data and information.
* Help coordinate cross-functional operational initiatives and ensure action items are followed through.
* Support scheduling, logistics, vendor coordination, purchasing, or other administrative activities as needed.
* Identify opportunities to improve organization, communication, and efficiency within day-to-day operations.

**Communication & Cross-Functional Coordination:**

* Serve as a reliable point of coordination between Project Management, Operations, and other internal departments.
* Communicate project and operational updates clearly and professionally.
* Follow up proactively with stakeholders to keep tasks and initiatives moving.
* Build positive working relationships across teams and contribute to a collaborative work environment.
* Ensure information, decisions, and action items are documented and communicated appropriately.

**Training and Capability:**

* Provide training and education to clinic staff on approved project-specific workflows, compliance regulations, process improvement methodologies, safety protocols, and best practices.
* Support operational and quality-improvement initiatives when assigned as formal projects, while functional authority remains with the responsible department leader.
* Other duties as assigned.

**REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE AND COMPETENCIES:**

* **Project coordination fundamentals**, including supporting scope, timelines, milestones, deliverables, budgets, and risk tracking.
* **Strong oral and written communication**, including preparing project updates, status reports, meeting materials, and other communications for internal stakeholders and leadership.
* **Problem-solving and issue identification**, including recognizing potential risks, delays, or barriers and escalating them appropriately.
* **Critical thinking and sound judgment**, with the ability to assess priorities, identify next steps, and know when to seek guidance or escalate concerns.
* **Project tracking and accountability**, including maintaining action items, monitoring deliverables and deadlines, and supporting the collection and reporting of project outcomes.
* **Familiarity with clinic operations**, sufficient to effectively coordinate with clinical, administrative, and operational teams.
* **Strong time-management and organizational skills**, including the ability to coordinate multiple projects, priorities, and competing deadlines.
* **Cross-functional collaboration and influence**, including the ability to build relationships, facilitate communication, and gain cooperation across departments without direct authority.
* **Attention to detail

jobs.title: Quality Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
WelbeHealth is a value-based healthcare organization that's transforming the future of senior care by providing an all-inclusive care option to our most vulnerable senior population. We step in as the care provider and care planner that work to keep our participants within their communities, out of institutions, and cared for like family, all while receiving the healthcare and social services needed to thrive.

Under the supervision of the Quality Operations Supervisor, the Quality Operations Coordinator (QOC) will be responsible for delivering excellent support and service to our PACE market operations through a process of record review to ensure a complete and accurate participant medical record. Responsibilities will include collecting data, auditing participant electronic health records by utilizing comprehensive tools specific to the area of quality improvement, complete reporting and confirming all regulatory required elements. This role collaborates effectively with colleagues and stakeholders to promote the WelbeHealth values, team culture and mission.

**This role is different because the Quality Operations Coordinator at WelbeHealth:**

* Plays a direct role in the quality and accuracy of participant care, ensuring medical records are complete, accurate, timely, and compliant with regulatory requirements. Your work helps identify gaps in documentation and supports our care teams in maintaining the highest standards of quality for our participants.
* Combines quality auditing with meaningful process improvement, giving you the opportunity to identify trends and deficiencies, investigate root causes, and collaborate with clinical and operational teams to strengthen processes, improve documentation, and support regulatory readiness across the PACE organization.

**We care about our team members. That's why we offer:**

* Medical insurance coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)
* Work/life balance - We mean it! 17 days of personal time off (PTO), 12 holidays observed annually, and 6 sick days
* 401K savings + match
* Comprehensive compensation package including base pay and bonus
* And additional benefits!

**On the day-to-day, you will:**

* Identify potential deficiencies, facilitate, and monitor appropriate corrections to ensure data integrity in the EHR. Monitor participant medical records for complete and timely documentation and promptly report to Quality Operations Supervisor when policies and procedures are not being followed
* Participate in team documentation, process improvements and other QO team initiatives
* Conduct medical records audits to ensure all required documentation is timely and accurate
* Assist with WelbeHealth audits by preparing documents for desk review submission (universe lists) as well as assist with EMR navigation and impact analysis
* Review and reconcile assigned regulatory logs
* Complete all required tasks in a timely and accurate manner
* Complete required investigations and notifications

**Job requirements include:**

* Associate's degree preferred; may substitute three years' experience in lieu of education
* Minimum two (2) years' work experience in a healthcare setting or related areas
* Familiarity with healthcare quality standards, auditing, regulatory requirements, documentation, and maintaining operational controls in a regulated environment
* Experience working with grievances, complaints, appeals, or member/provider issues within a healthcare, health plan, managed care, PACE, or other regulated healthcare environment is highly desired
* Bilingual is a plus
* Ability to multi-task in a challenging environment is necessary; Excellent communication, listening, and organization skills
* Extensive MS office suite experience (Intermediate to advanced level proficiency is desired)

If you're detail-oriented and passionate about healthcare quality, auditing, and continuous improvement, we'd love to hear from you!

**COVID-19 Vaccination Policy**

At WelbeHealth, our mission is to unlock the full potential of our vulnerable seniors. In this spirit, please note that we have a vaccination policy for all our employees and proof of vaccination, or a vaccine declination form will be required prior to employment. WelbeHealth maintains required infection control and PPE standards and has requirements relevant to all team members regarding vaccinations.

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**

At WelbeHealth, we embrace and cherish the diversity of our team members, and we're committed to building a culture of inclusion and belonging. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. People seeking employment at WelbeHealth are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member), pregnancy or other status protected by applicable law.

  

**Beware of Scams**

Please ensure your application is being submitted through a WelbeHealth sponsored site only. Our emails will come from @welbehealth.com email addresses. You will never be asked to purchase your own employment equipment. You can report suspected scam activity to fraud.report@welbehealth.com

jobs.title: Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
#### **What’s in it for you…**

* Insurance enrollment available from DAY 1!
* Paid time off available from DAY 1!
* Holiday pay available from DAY 1!
* 401(k) enrollment after 30 days!
* Hotel and travel discounts at worldwide destinations!
* Professional development and promotion opportunities!

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ABOUT DOT.CARDS**
===================

dot.cards is the digital business card of the future. We produce premium networking hardware that pairs with a software platform that lets anyone share their contact info, in seconds. Based in LA, we are a revenue-backed, fast-growing company entering our next phase of growth.

**THE ROLE**
============

We are hiring an Operations Coordinator to support the Head of Operations. This is a full-time, entry-level role for someone who wants to learn how a hardware company runs, from the factory to the customer.

Reporting directly to the Head of Operations, you will act as their right hand on operations: keeping inventory, suppliers, shipments, and reporting on track, and making sure commitments made get done.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**
====================

* Coordinate with customer support, sales, procurement and the warehouse to support the custom product order process from order confirmation to delivery.
* Support weekly Amazon FBA replenishment: build the order, confirm inventory quantities, and review with Head of Operations for approval of shipping carton labels.
* Assist the Head of Sales by tracking action items from meetings, and follow up directly with owners on status and deadlines until each one is closed
* Track product development status, collect prototype and production quotes, sample shipments, follow up on action items and keep the product development tracker current.
* Coordinate monthly sales and operations planning (S&OP) readiness across departments and schedule meetings accordingly.
* Write and maintain SOPs for recurring operations workflows and flag any workflow that has not been written down yet.
* Coordinate in-house sample production, prioritize production schedule maintain inventory levels and document most effective customization parameters.
* Maintain one running list of open items with owner and due date and flag anything overdue or at risk.
* Check vendor invoices and forward them to accounts payable and receipts to our expense system
* Set up new SKUs, bundles, and maintain item master data in our document control database.
* Handle office facilities requests, including cleaning and other vendors and landlord requests
* Draft decks, spreadsheets, and briefs for review
* Order lab and office supplies and keep them stocked

**WHAT YOU WILL LEARN**
=======================

* How a hardware company runs operations end to end, working directly with the Head of Sales and Operations
* Supply chain and procurement with overseas manufacturers, from purchase order to delivered goods
* 3PL fulfillment and inventory planning across Shopify, Amazon, and TikTok Shop
* How operations reporting drives purchasing and planning decisions

  **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**
  ===========================

**Required**
------------

* 1 to 3 years of experience in an operations, logistics, coordinator, or executive assistant role, ideally in a fast-moving environment; also open to recent graduates and students in their final year of study with relevant internship or part-time experience
* Interest in supply chain, logistics, or manufacturing, through coursework, internships, or work experience
* Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets: comfortable with formulas, pivot tables, and building trackers from scratch
* Detail-oriented and organized, comfortable juggling multiple trackers, deadlines, and follow-ups at once
* Comfortable following up with people, including holding others accountable to deadlines they have committed to
* Clear written communicator who can draft a professional email or message without heavy editing
* Reliable, shows up, and follows through without needing reminders
* Comfortable asking questions and flagging problems early rather than guessing
* Able to lift and pack boxes up to 25 lbs

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience with Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, or a 3PL or warehouse management portal

**COMPENSATION & DETAILS**
==========================

* $29.00 to $34.00/hour
* Full-time, entry level
* Onsite at dot.cards HQ in Culver City, CA
* Start date: as soon as we find the right person
* Reports to: Head of Sales and Operations

The Social Media Coordinator/ Content Creator reports to the Head of Social and is responsible for executing high-impact, social-first video content that drives engagement, brand awareness, and revenue growth across Our Place. This role is hands-on and execution-focused, with ownership of day-to-day TikTok content creation, video production, community-driven initiatives, specific Founder-led content, and platform growth strategies. The Social Media Coordinator/ Content Creator partners closely with the Founders, Creative, and Marketing teams to bring the brand to life through compelling, timely, and culturally relevant content.

**We have a hybrid working culture and are looking for this person to be on site 2 - 3 times a week at our brand new Our Place headquarters in West Los Angeles.**

jobs.title: Regional Account Manager (Fitness)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

The Fitness Regional Account Manager (RAM) is responsible for driving sales and executing Red Bull strategies and initiatives across assigned Fitness & Gym key accounts within their territory. This role also supports designated National Fitness Account groups by expanding distribution, ensuring executional excellence, and delivering impactful marketing activations aligned with RBNA On Premise standards.

This role is also eligible to sit in the following locations: Phoenix, AZ; Houston, TX

 **Job Description**

**REGIONAL FITNESS KEY ACCOUNT & FRANCHISE GROUP MANAGEMENT**

Manages sales funnel of current and targeted Regional Fitness Key Account parnters.

Build relationships and incentive programs with Regional Fitness distributors to drive growth in independent & chain business.

Builds strong, mutually beneficial relationships with key account decision makers and stakeholders.

Creates account programming such as promotions, staff programs, and tradeshow support etc. that are relevant to each account and drives volume.

Negotiates key accounts contracts to drive execution and programming while maintaining appropriate spends per case.

Develops strong go-to-market strategies to launch distribution & execution with Fitness Key Account partners.

Works closely with Senior Manager – National Fitness to drive programming through region-based franchise groups.

Conducts regular account audits directly or through regional On Premise teams to ensure agreed upon account standards are met.

Participates in relevant Trade Shows and Conferences to keep up with industry standards that can be leveraged in negotiation and creating account solutions.

**ACCOUNT ANALYSIS & REVIEWS**

Conducts regular business reviews to drive accountability with partners to deliver upon agreed execution, programming, and volume commitments.

Leverages business insights to appeal to customer’s needs and influence gains in distribution, execution, and programming.

Identifies best practices that can be scaled in other regions, or nationally across other franchise groups.

**COMMUNICATION & STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT**

Works closely with National Teams as well as Region On Premise Marketing (Trade & Retail) Marketing to create custom account programming in line with brand standards.

Aligns regional stakeholders (i.e., General Management, Directors, On Premise Team) around account priorities to reinforce execution and give/receive feedback to maximize account performance.

Conducts regular reviews with region leaders around account performance, programming results, and balance of year focus areas to ensure business plan achievement.

Regularly engages and informs Fitness Distributor Partners National and Regional Fitness Account priorities, programs, and initiatives to drive alignment and ensure product availability in all accounts.

**PLANNING & REPORTING**

Establishes and manages volume and spend budget by account via Customer Profitability Management (CPM) system, constantly analyzing ROI and rate per case to maximize resource allocation.

Plans all volume forecasts via CPM, tracking monthly by account chain to manage account performance.

Ensures that internal tools are up to date with chain/ account level detail, including unit listings, mandated SKUs and agreed upon executional elements.

 **Qualifications**

5+ years of On Premise sales experience with demonstrated success of building and executing plans with top outlets, preferably with account groups. Experience selling to Fitness Operators heavily preferred.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess and utilize business insights to influence internal and external partners to drive sales.

Excellent communication (written & verbal), presentation and negotiation skills.

Demonstrable creativity and solution-orientated thinking that has driven account results that speak to consumer and account needs.

Self-motivated with an entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to work independently.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

Bachelor’s Degree required.

Must be fluent in English, additional language skills an advantage.

 **Additional Information**

This position is open to U.S. citizens, U.S. permanent residents, or individuals who are currently authorized to work in the United States on a valid visa.  
  
The base salary range for this position is **$92,000 - 138,000** + cash incentives. Actual salary offers may vary based on work experience. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified.  
  
Our current Benefits include:  
Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision Plans, 401k Match, Family Leave, PTO & Paid Holiday Schedule, Pet, Legal, and Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement (Benefits listed may vary depending on the nature of your employment and/or work location).

Red Bull North America, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, or any other classification protected by Federal, state, or local law. We will consider for employment all qualified Applicants, including those with Criminal Histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.

jobs.title: Cardiovascular Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Description**

The Cardiovascular Sales Representative (CSR) is responsible for achieving or exceeding sales goals within an assigned geography while operating in a compliant and ethical manner. This role develops and executes territory strategies, identifies customer needs, and drives results. Using strong analytical skills, the CSR evaluates regional market data to build and implement strategic territory business plans, foster lasting professional relationships, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners. The ideal candidate has strong business acumen, is resourceful, self-motivated, results-oriented, and collaborative.

**Responsibilities**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key customers and accounts with the goal of maximizing sales.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with targeted physicians to maximize new business opportunities.
* Achieve success in a complex, matrixed selling environment in which the need for collaboration and cross-functional discipline is critical. Cross-functional partners may consist of FRMs, TLLs, Market Access, Medical, Marketing and Operations colleagues.
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers.
* Use data tools and insights, and other informational sources such as next best action, to determine strategies and tactics for business decision-making.
* Demonstrate account-based selling skills (including group presentations, etc.).
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action.
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities.
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner.
* Execute the company’s brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area.
* Participation in training and development programs.
* Comply with all legal, regulatory and compliance policies and demonstrate a high level of integrity and professionalism at all times.
* Additional duties as required.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Business or a related field required.
* 3+ years of pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical sales experience.
* 2+ years of cardiovascular/cardiometabolic strongly preferred.
* Experience in highly managed, payor-controlled markets is strongly preferred.
* Consistent track record of documented top-tier sales accomplishments.
* Experience calling on assigned targets in the designated territory geography highly desired.
* Experience launching products in competitive marketplace.
* Ability to learn complex scientific information, apply technical proficiency and effectively communicate.
* Must be self-motivated and able to work with a high level of autonomy and independence.
* Strong technical & analytical skills including proficiency with CRM, AI tools and Microsoft Office Suite.
* A valid driver’s license and ability to travel as needed, which may include overnight and/or weekend travel.

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $120,000 to $130,000. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.

The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic and innovative Social Media Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will create content for our Founder, film and edit, develop and execute comprehensive social media strategies across multiple platforms to enhance brand visibility, engage target audiences, and drive digital marketing performance. The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of social media management tools, content creation. This position offers an exciting opportunity to shape our online presence through creative content, strategic campaigns, and data-driven insights.

**Duties**

* Film, implement, and manage social media marketing campaigns across platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, and TikTok to increase brand awareness and engagement.
* Create compelling and high-quality content including graphics, videos, photography, and written posts aligned with branding guidelines.
* Utilize media editing tools like Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and video editing software to produce visually appealing content.
* Monitor social media channels using management tools such as Hootsuite or Buffer to schedule posts, track engagement metrics, and optimize posting schedules.
* Conduct social listening to gather insights on audience sentiment, industry trends, and competitor activities for strategic planning.
* Analyze social media analytics and marketing performance data using Google Analytics and platform-specific tools to measure campaign effectiveness.
* Manage relationships with influencers, media contacts, and community members to foster positive brand interactions.
* Implement SEO best practices and keyword research techniques to enhance content discoverability.
* Oversee paid advertising campaigns on platforms like Facebook Ads Manager to maximize reach and ROI.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including PR, content writers, graphic designers, and web developers to ensure cohesive messaging.
* Prepare reports on social media performance metrics for continuous improvement and strategic adjustments.

**Experience**

* Proven experience in social media management within a digital marketing environment or related field.
* Strong proficiency with social listening tools, media editing software (Adobe Creative Suite), and social media management applications such as Hootsuite or Buffer.
* Demonstrated ability in content creation including graphic design, photography, video editing, and proofreading.
* Knowledge of SEO principles, web analytics (Google Analytics), and marketing online analytics.
* Familiarity with public relations strategies and relationship management techniques.
* Experience in executing paid advertising campaigns on social platforms like Facebook Advertising is preferred.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to craft engaging messages tailored for diverse audiences.

If you are passionate about leveraging digital channels to build brands through innovative content creation and strategic communication, we welcome your application. Join us in shaping compelling online narratives that resonate globally while advancing your career in digital marketing.

Benefits:

jobs.description:
Are you a kid at heart looking to build a career with a leading global children's toy, entertainment and digital gaming company?

At Spin Master, our unwavering commitment to open mindedness, integrity and innovation is a great part of what has made us an industry leader. How do we stay ahead of the pack? By hiring the best and brightest minds—and that’s why we want you!

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**What will you work on?**  
As the public voice and real-time managing editor for our brands, you will own our community engagement strategy across all social platforms. This is a highly autonomous role where you will apply your deep knowledge of platform culture and algorithms to independently make strategic and editorial judgments on copy, public engagement, and trend response without routine managerial sign-off. Your mission is to protect and nurture our brand reputation while translating cultural trends into strategic opportunities.  
  
**How will you create impact?**

* Act as the primary cultural sensor for the brand, mining platform, audience, and cultural (PAC) signals to determine which trends and conversations warrant action.
* Own the brand’s real-time response strategy, independently determining if, when, and how to engage with breaking news and cultural moments.
* Monitor and interpret consumer conversations, comments, and sentiment to identify strategic patterns and creative opportunities.
* Analyze in-market social creative and provide real-time optimization recommendations to internal and external partners.
* Use social listening and data tools to synthesize consumer insights that inform future creative development and campaign direction.
* Maintain platform hygiene through diligent sentiment monitoring, community moderation, and strategic escalation to protect brand reputation.

**What are your skills and experience?**

* Deep, native expertise in the algorithms, trend cycles, and content formats of key social platforms (e.g., TikTok, Instagram, YouTube).
* Professional experience in social media strategy, creative strategy, or digital marketing, preferably within a fast-paced agency or consumer brand environment.
* Proven ability to partner with video editors and creators to quickly develop and refine social-first content based on real-time performance.
* A strong editorial eye and the ability to make autonomous, high-stakes judgment calls on brand voice and public response.
* A demonstrated history of identifying emerging cultural trends and translating them into successful, brand-aligned creative concepts

**Job Responsibilities**

The Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Specialist will be responsible for managing Sunmerry’s digital presence and ensuring our brand, products, promotions, and store information are accurately represented across all online channels.

Social Media

\* Manage Sunmerry’s social media platforms, including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and other relevant channels.

\* Maintain and execute the social media content calendar.

\* Coordinate and assist with photos, videos, Reels, and other content.

\* Write captions, schedule posts, and monitor customer engagement.

\* Stay current on social media and food trends and identify opportunities for new content.

E-Commerce & Third-Party Delivery

\* Manage Sunmerry’s presence on Uber Eats, DoorDash, Weee, and other online sales platforms.

\* Maintain product listings, pricing, descriptions, photos, promotions, and availability.

\* Coordinate new product launches and seasonal promotions across digital platforms.

\* Monitor online sales and platform performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

Website, Google & SEO

\* Maintain and update website content, including products, promotions, and store information.

\* Manage Google Business Profiles for all Sunmerry locations.

\* Perform basic SEO work to improve Sunmerry’s visibility in online searches.

\* Monitor website traffic and search performance.

Digital Marketing

\* Support digital campaigns for new products, seasonal launches, and company promotions.

\* Assist with email marketing and other customer communication channels.

jobs.title: Sales Representative (Entry-Level B2B)
jobs.description:
ADP is hiring a **Sales Representative, Small Business Services.**

Are you ready to build a rewarding future? Uncapped commissions, lavish incentive trips, and career advancement are some of the ways.  

Do you want to join a Fortune 250 company with industry-leading sales training and the latest sales technology to help you achieve success?  
* Are you looking to join a fast-paced, inclusive environment with a culture of collaboration and belonging?

If so, this may be the opportunity you've been searching for. Read on and decide for yourself.

In this role, you will work within a defined geographic territory that targets clients and prospects with 1-49 employees. You will identify and sign new clients for payroll, tax, human resources, benefits, and more and sell additional solutions to existing clients. Daily, you will cultivate relationships, set appointments, gather leads from established business partners, assess client or prospect needs to present the best ADP solutions, and spend your time in the field closing business. Don't worry if you have no prior sales experience; we are known for our high-quality sales training and will teach you how to use the latest sales technology to set you up for success.

Integrity, resilience, positivity, and a refuse to lose attitude are must-haves in this job. As with any role in sales, you will experience ebbs and flows. However, challenges should ignite your determination and invigorate you to thrive, not weigh you down. In return, you'll be rewarded with uncapped commissions, incentive trips, and opportunities to advance your career in a fun and friendly environment - all while gaining serious credibility as part of an industry-leading sales team in a stable and highly respected tech company.

Ready to #MakeYourMark? **Apply now!**

**To learn more about Sales at ADP,** watch here: http://adp.careers/Sales\_Videos

**What you'll do:** Responsibilities

* **Grow Our Business While Growing Yours.** You will work independently and collaboratively as part of various teams within your assigned geography to close sales, win business, and reach sales goals.
* **Turn Prospects into Loyal Clients and Raving Fans.** You will implement a sales strategy targeted to decision-makers and business owners to build a network and capture new business.
* **Deepen Relationships Across the ADP Family.** In addition to selling cloud-based human resources solutions, you will strategically cultivate additional business within existing accounts. But it's not all business; you will make life-long friendships here.
* **Collaborate Daily.** You will serve as a trusted advisor, partner, and ADP ambassador to your clients, internal partners, and overall network while demonstrating grace under pressure and the highest ethical standards.

**#LI-CD2**

**TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:** Required Qualifications

* **Positive Self-Starter.** You have an upbeat, persistent style and the ability to cold call without fear of rejection, manage your time well, and can present your ideas in a clear professional manner on paper, in-person, and over the phone.
* **Agile Solution Seeker.** You're a problem solver who can find an answer, or a solution, even in times of fast-paced change.
* **Continuous Learner.** You're always learning, growing, and questioning how things were done in the past to make them even better.
* **Technology & Digital Acumen.** You are comfortable leveraging modern digital tools and platforms-including AI-to work smarter and more efficiently. You adopt new technologies quickly, use data to inform decisions, and continuously explore ways to enhance productivity and results through innovation.

A college degree is great but not required. What's more important is having the skills to do the job. Other acceptable experiences could include:

One to two years of prior work experience or internships in Retail, Marketing, Business Development, Food Service, Insurance Sales, or another relevant industry, OR  

* Military experience We recognize and appreciate the unique talents and experiences Veterans bring to the table. We value the discipline, commitment, and problem-solving abilities you have developed and are excited to provide an environment where you can continue to make a meaningful impact.

**Bonus points for these:** Preferred Qualifications

Prior quota-carrying experience  

* Ability to successfully build a network and effectively use social media for sales

**YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:**

* **Be yourself** in a culture that values equity, inclusion, and belonging and creates a safe space for diverse perspectives and insights.
* **Belong** by joining one of our Business Resource Groups where you can connect globally with networks and allies who share common interests and experiences.
* **Grow your career** in an agile, fast-paced environment with plenty of opportunities to progress.
* **Continuously learn** through ongoing training, development, and mentorship opportunities.
* **Be your healthiest.** Best-in-class benefits start on Day 1 because healthy associates are happy ones.
* **Balance work and life.** Resources and flexibility to more easily integrate your work and your life.
* **Focus on your mental health and well-being.** We're here to provide exceptional service to our clients, and none of that happens without each of us taking care of ourselves and being there for one another.
* **Join a company committed to giving back** and generating a lasting, positive impact upon the communities in which we work and live.
* **Get paid to pay it forward.** Company-paid time off for volunteering for causes you care about.

What are you waiting for? **Apply today!**

**#LI-CD2**

Base salary offers for this position may vary based on factors such as location, skills, and relevant experience. Some positions may include additional compensation in the form of bonus, equity or commissions. We offer the following benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insu

jobs.description:
**Territory:** Los Angeles & Inland Empire, California  
**Industry:** Licensed Cannabis  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

About the Role

We are a licensed California cannabis brand looking for a motivated, relationship-driven **Outside Sales Representative** to grow our retail presence across the **Los Angeles and Inland Empire markets**.

This is a field-based sales role focused on developing relationships with licensed cannabis dispensaries, introducing our products to buyers and purchasing teams, growing existing accounts, and driving consistent sell-through.

The ideal candidate knows the California cannabis retail landscape, is comfortable walking into dispensaries and meeting decision-makers, and understands that successful cannabis sales are built on **relationships, follow-through, product knowledge, and consistent account management**.

Responsibilities

* Identify and develop relationships with licensed cannabis dispensaries throughout LA and the Inland Empire
* Prospect new retail accounts through in-person visits, phone, email, and industry networking
* Build relationships with dispensary owners, buyers, purchasing managers, and retail teams
* Present our brand, products, pricing, promotions, and wholesale programs to prospective accounts
* Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting and product presentation through order placement and follow-up
* Grow sales within existing accounts through regular store visits and relationship management
* Monitor inventory, pricing, promotions, and product placement at retail accounts
* Work with dispensary teams to identify opportunities to increase product visibility and sell-through
* Maintain accurate records of prospects, accounts, orders, and sales activity
* Stay informed on California cannabis regulations, market trends, competitive products, and retail dynamics
* Represent the brand professionally at dispensary visits, industry events, and other business-development opportunities
* Meet or exceed established sales and account-growth goals

What We're Looking For

* Proven outside sales experience; cannabis industry experience strongly preferred
* Existing relationships with California cannabis dispensaries and/or buyers is a major plus
* Strong understanding of the LA and/or Inland Empire cannabis retail market
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
* Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a field-sales environment
* Highly organized with strong follow-up and account-management skills
* Professional presentation and ability to represent a premium cannabis brand
* Comfortable with frequent local travel and visiting multiple accounts throughout the territory
* **Must have reliable transportation and a valid driver's license**
* **Must be able to travel throughout the Los Angeles and Inland Empire territories as needed**
* Must be **21+** and able to meet all applicable California cannabis industry requirements

What We Offer

* Competitive base salary + commission structure
* Opportunity for significant earning potential as the territory grows
* Mileage/travel reimbursement or company vehicle program, if applicable
* Flexible field-based schedule
* Opportunity to grow with an expanding California cannabis brand
* Supportive team environment
* Product and brand training

Compensation will be commensurate with experience, existing industry relationships, and demonstrated sales performance.

How to Apply

Please submit your **resume and a brief introduction** highlighting your cannabis sales experience, territory knowledge, and existing relationships with California dispensaries.

If you have an established network of cannabis retailers in **Los Angeles and/or the Inland Empire**, we want to hear from you.

**GT Ventures is an equal opportunity employer.**

Pay: $45,000.00 - $103,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Mileage reimbursement
* Opportunities for advancement
* Paid training
* Professional development assistance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Los Angeles, CA 90041

**Description**

The Cardiovascular Sales Representative (CSR) is responsible for achieving or exceeding sales goals within an assigned geography while operating in a compliant and ethical manner. This role develops and executes territory strategies, identifies customer needs, and drives results. Using strong analytical skills, the CSR evaluates regional market data to build and implement strategic territory business plans, foster lasting professional relationships, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners. The ideal candidate has strong business acumen, is resourceful, self-motivated, results-oriented, and collaborative.

**Responsibilities**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key customers and accounts with the goal of maximizing sales.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with targeted physicians to maximize new business opportunities.
* Achieve success in a complex, matrixed selling environment in which the need for collaboration and cross-functional discipline is critical. Cross-functional partners may consist of FRMs, TLLs, Market Access, Medical, Marketing and Operations colleagues.
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers.
* Use data tools and insights, and other informational sources such as next best action, to determine strategies and tactics for business decision-making.
* Demonstrate account-based selling skills (including group presentations, etc.).
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action.
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities.
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner.
* Execute the company’s brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area.
* Participation in training and development programs.
* Comply with all legal, regulatory and compliance policies and demonstrate a high level of integrity and professionalism at all times.
* Additional duties as required.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Business or a related field required.
* 3+ years of pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical sales experience.
* 2+ years of cardiovascular/cardiometabolic strongly preferred.
* Experience in highly managed, payor-controlled markets is strongly preferred.
* Consistent track record of documented top-tier sales accomplishments.
* Experience calling on assigned targets in the designated territory geography highly desired.
* Experience launching products in competitive marketplace.
* Ability to learn complex scientific information, apply technical proficiency and effectively communicate.
* Must be self-motivated and able to work with a high level of autonomy and independence.
* Strong technical & analytical skills including proficiency with CRM, AI tools and Microsoft Office Suite.
* A valid driver’s license and ability to travel as needed, which may include overnight and/or weekend travel.

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $120,000 to $130,000. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. jobs.description:
**PAYMENT SOLUTIONS CONSULTANT**  
**Los Angeles, CA | On-site role**

  

Founded in 2021, NowPay LLC is proud to be a part of the family of Hankey Group companies. With assets over $30 billion combined, the Hankey Group has a 50-year track record of being an innovator in the automobile and finance industries led by our companies Westlake Financial, Nowcom and many others.

Based out of our Los Angeles office, NowPay is a full-service registered ISO/MSP that offers merchant services, business software and various other payment technology solutions that intend to help our clients operate effectively. We are driven to continuously develop new products and services to solve the ever-expanding need of small, medium and large businesses to connect with financial institutions and consumers. Our company conducts merchant underwriting, risk, onboarding and support in-house.

NowPay has a people-first culture with an emphasis on honesty and integrity whether it is with our employees, clients or partners. We are seeking experienced professionals to join the NowPay family and be an integral part of our rapid growth. Join our team if you are ready to make an impact today!

  

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a motivated and results-driven Sales Executive to join our growing merchant services and payment processing company. This individual will be responsible for generating new business opportunities, managing inbound and outbound sales activities, conducting merchant consultations, and closing payment processing agreements with businesses across the United States.

The ideal candidate has experience in merchant services, payment processing, financial services, SaaS sales, or B2B sales and is comfortable working with both cold and warm leads. This role requires strong relationship-building skills, consultative selling abilities, and occasional travel for client meetings, trade shows, industry events, and partner development opportunities.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**New Business Development**

* Prospect and identify new merchant opportunities through outbound calling, email campaigns, networking, referrals, and strategic partnerships (includes both warm and cold leads).
* Follow up promptly with inbound leads generated through marketing campaigns, referral partners, and company initiatives.
* Schedule and conduct sales presentations, discovery calls, and product demonstrations.
* Develop and maintain a robust sales pipeline using the company's CRM system.
* Gather signed merchant applications and support documents or stipulations for our Underwriting department to review.

  

**Merchant Consultation & Sales**

* Analyze prospective merchants' current payment processing solutions and identify opportunities for savings and operational improvements.
* Present customized solutions including:
* + Credit card processing
  + ACH processing
  + Payment gateways
  + Virtual terminals
  + Point-of-sale systems
  + Recurring billing solutions
  + E-commerce payment solutions
  + Other proprietary software solutions
* Prepare pricing proposals and negotiate agreements.
* Close new merchant accounts and achieve monthly sales targets.

  

**Relationship Management**

* Serve as a trusted advisor throughout the sales process.
* Coordinate with underwriting, risk, operations, and customer support teams to facilitate smooth merchant onboarding.
* Maintain ongoing relationships with merchants to identify additional sales opportunities and referrals.
* Support strategic partner and referral relationships.

  

**Travel & Industry Representation**

* Conduct in-person meetings with prospective merchants and referral partners.
* Travel as needed to support business development initiatives.

  

**Sales Administration**

* Maintain accurate records of all sales activities in CRM.
* Track pipeline performance and forecast monthly sales results.
* Prepare reports on sales activities, opportunities, and closed business.
* Stay informed regarding industry trends, payment technologies, card brand regulations, and competitive offerings.

  

**Performance Metrics**

Success in this role will be measured by:

* New merchant accounts approved and activated
* Monthly processing volume generated
* Revenue and gross profit produced
* Lead conversion rates
* Pipeline growth and management
* Merchant retention and satisfaction
* Referral partner development

  

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 2+ years of B2B sales experience in merchant services, payment processing, and fintech space.
* Understanding of credit card processing, ACH processing, POS systems, processing fees, merchant underwriting processes.
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Proven ability to generate leads and close business.
* Experience managing a sales pipeline and CRM system.
* Self-motivated with strong organizational skills.
* Ability to travel as needed.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
* Existing network of business owners, referral partners, or industry contacts a plus.

  

**PAY RATE:**

* **Pay Rate:** $20/hour + potential performance-based bonus and uncapped commission.

  + **On-Target Earnings (OTE):** $100,000 to $150,000
  + **Guaranteed Ramp-Up:** First 2 months guaranteed $3,850 bonus per month plus base pay.
  + **Commission Paid Per Deal**
  + **Potential Residual Income**
* The exact starting compensation to be offered will be determined at the time of selecting an applicant for hire and will be dependent on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to geographic location, skill set, experience, education, credentials, and licensure when applicable.

  

**FULL TIME BENEFITS**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
* Life Insurance and Long-term disability plans
* Flexible Spending Account
* 401K matching
* Employee Stock Ownership Program in a $18.2 Billion Company, plus company matching

**Description**

The Cardiovascular Sales Representative (CSR) is responsible for achieving or exceeding sales goals within an assigned geography while operating in a compliant and ethical manner. This role develops and executes territory strategies, identifies customer needs, and drives results. Using strong analytical skills, the CSR evaluates regional market data to build and implement strategic territory business plans, foster lasting professional relationships, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners. The ideal candidate has strong business acumen, is resourceful, self-motivated, results-oriented, and collaborative.

**Responsibilities**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key customers and accounts with the goal of maximizing sales.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with targeted physicians to maximize new business opportunities.
* Achieve success in a complex, matrixed selling environment in which the need for collaboration and cross-functional discipline is critical. Cross-functional partners may consist of FRMs, TLLs, Market Access, Medical, Marketing and Operations colleagues.
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers.
* Use data tools and insights, and other informational sources such as next best action, to determine strategies and tactics for business decision-making.
* Demonstrate account-based selling skills (including group presentations, etc.).
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action.
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities.
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner.
* Execute the company’s brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area.
* Participation in training and development programs.
* Comply with all legal, regulatory and compliance policies and demonstrate a high level of integrity and professionalism at all times.
* Additional duties as required.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Business or a related field required.
* 3+ years of pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical sales experience.
* 2+ years of cardiovascular/cardiometabolic strongly preferred.
* Experience in highly managed, payor-controlled markets is strongly preferred.
* Consistent track record of documented top-tier sales accomplishments.
* Experience calling on assigned targets in the designated territory geography highly desired.
* Experience launching products in competitive marketplace.
* Ability to learn complex scientific information, apply technical proficiency and effectively communicate.
* Must be self-motivated and able to work with a high level of autonomy and independence.
* Strong technical & analytical skills including proficiency with CRM, AI tools and Microsoft Office Suite.
* A valid driver’s license and ability to travel as needed, which may include overnight and/or weekend travel.

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $120,000 to $130,000. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. In addition, some positions may include eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.

Join our game-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.

Work Here Matters Everywhere | How are you inspired to change lives?

**Project Coordinator, Lab Operations**
---------------------------------------

**Natera** | Entry-Level | Lab Operations

### **About Natera**

Natera is a global leader in cell-free DNA testing, with diagnostic solutions spanning Women's Health, Oncology, Organ Health, and Rare Disease. Our work helps clinicians and patients make earlier, better-informed health decisions, and our teams are driven by the impact of that mission every day.

### **About the Role**

As a Project Coordinator on our Lab Operations team, you'll be the organizational backbone that keeps cross-functional projects moving. You'll support Program and Project Managers across a variety of department initiatives, handling the scheduling, documentation, and tracking that help teams deliver on time and within scope. This is an excellent entry point for someone early in their career who wants hands-on exposure to project management in a fast-paced, science-driven environment.

### **What You'll Do**

* Prepare and distribute meeting agendas, capture meeting minutes, and maintain action item and decision logs
* Track project deliverables and follow up on document approvals, including design control documentation, under the direction of the Program Manager
* Maintain and update project schedules and Gantt charts to keep status and timelines accurate
* Schedule and coordinate project team meetings and manage logistics so issues are resolved quickly
* Adapt to shifting priorities and support multiple projects or programs as needed
* Perform other duties as assigned

### **What You'll Bring**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in a scientific, engineering, or related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
* 0–2 years of experience in a project support, administrative, or coordination role (internships and co-ops count)
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to juggle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills, and comfort working with cross-functional teams and leadership
* Proven ability to prioritize, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing priorities
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or similar productivity tools, and a willingness to learn new systems quickly
* A proactive, dependable, team-oriented approach

**Nice to Have**

* Coursework or exposure to life sciences, molecular biology, or genetics
* Familiarity with project tracking concepts such as Gantt charts, action item logs, or project schedules
* Experience with tools like Confluence, Jira, Smartsheet, MS Project, or SharePoint

### **Work Environment**

This is primarily an office-based role. You'll use a computer keyboard, communicate by phone and video, and read printed and digital material. Occasional work outside normal business hours, including evenings and weekends, may be required.

**OUR OPPORTUNITY**

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women's health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you'll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you'll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent.
