**Job Description**
-------------------

Open to candidates who are permanent.
  
  
The New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene’s Division of Environmental Health works to prevent and control illness and injury related to environmental and occupational health risks through outreach, education, surveillance, and enforcement. With staff of 1,000, the Division covers a broad range of subject matter, including oversight of environmental investigations, lead poisoning, prevention, occupational health, food safety, childcare, radiation control, recreational and drinking water quality, air quality, climate health, vector control, veterinary public health, and pest control. The Bureau of Food Safety and Community Sanitation (BFSCS) protects the public, including New York's most vulnerable citizens from a broad range of hazards that may pose a threat to health or safety. DOHMH is mandated to inspect 26,000 restaurants annually, school cafeterias, and mobile food vending unit, adult day care centers, senior centers, soup kitchens, homeless shelters, and other facilities.
  
  
DUTIES WILL INCLUDE BUT NOT BE LIMITED TO:
  

* Serve as a point of contact for all front-end MFV customer service interactions, maintaining high-quality care and effectively routing inquiries.
* Prepare and maintain various data and facility reports, logs, and tracking analyses to support informed decision-making by the Regional Director.
* Provide customer care services through phone and in-person interactions regarding mobile food vending permits and licenses, including guiding customers on required documentation.
* Assist in logistical planning and execution of operations, including scheduling appointments for Mobile Food Vendors pre-permit inspections, and inventory control.
* Organize and host training sessions, ensuring designated facility space is available for administrative and custodial staff.
* Address inquiries from the Bureau’s Health & Safety Coordinator and maintain compliance with health and safety regulations.
* Collaborate with Human Resources regarding personnel matters such as training and documentation.
* Work with the Director of Communications to ensure the facility has up-to-date literature and messaging for customer service needs.
* Support the Bureau’s Project Support Specialist with updates on vehicle usage and documentation.
* Coordinate with the Sr. Procurement Coordinator to monitor supplies and report any IT or resource issues.
* Assist with additional administrative duties and special projects as assigned to support the program.

  
PREFERRED SKILLS:
  

* Excellent communication skills.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Excellent decision making and problem-solving skills.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office
* Bilingual

  
Why you should work for us:
  
  

* Loan Forgiveness: As a prospective employee of the City of New York, you may be eligible for federal/state loan forgiveness and repayment assistance programs that lessen your payments or even fully forgive your full balance. For more information, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s website (https://studentaid.gov/pslf/)
* Benefits: City employees are entitled to unmatched benefits such as:

o a premium-free health insurance plan that saves employees over $10K annually, per a 2024 assessment.
  
o additional health, fitness, and financial benefits may be available based on the position’s associated union/benefit fund.
  
o a public sector defined benefit pension plan with steady monthly payments in retirement.
  
o a tax-deferred savings program and
  
o a robust Worksite Wellness Program that offers resources and opportunities to keep you healthy while serving New Yorkers.
  

* Work From Home Policy: Depending on your position, you may be able to work up to two days during the week from home.

- Job Security - you could enjoy more job security compared to private sector employment and be able to contribute to making NYC a healthy place to live and work.
  
  
Established in 1805, the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (NYC Health Department) is the oldest and largest health department in the U.S., dedicated to protecting and improving the health of NYC. Our mission is to safeguard the health of every resident and cultivate a city where everyone, regardless of age, background, or location, can achieve their optimal health. We provide a wide array of programs and services focused on food and nutrition, anti-tobacco support, chronic disease prevention, HIV/AIDS treatment, family and child health, environmental health, mental health, and social justice initiatives. As the primary population health strategist and policy authority for NYC, with a rich history of public health initiatives and scientific advancements, from addressing the 1822 yellow fever outbreak to the COVID-19 pandemic, we serve as a global leader in public health innovation and expertise.

Overview:

NRDC (the Natural Resources Defense Council) works to safeguard the Earth, its people, its plants and animals, and the natural systems on which all life depends. NRDC combines the power of more than 3 million members and online activists with the expertise of some 800 policy advocates, lawyers, scientists, and communication experts to confront the climate crisis, protect nature, ensure the rights of all people to clean air, clean water, and healthy communities. As an international nonprofit environmental organization, NRDC is working to address the world’s most urgent environmental challenges, and advance innovative, science-based, and enforceable solutions.

Since our founding in 1970, NRDC has helped craft and deliver many of America’s foundational environmental laws, including the Clean Air Act, Clean Water Act and Safe Drinking Water Act. Today, we continue to lead in advancing and defending strong environmental protections at the local, state, federal and international levels, as well as through the marketplace. Our team works across the United States and around the world, from offices in Chicago, Los Angeles, New York City, San Francisco, and Washington, D.C., as well as in Beijing, and New Delhi (a subsidiary of NRDC India Pvt. new_jobs.description:
We're Future, a global leader in specialist media. Our people bring our trusted brands to life, helping millions of people discover expert content that informs, inspires, and drives action. As a pioneering multiplatform media powerhouse, we provide expert content and technology that build valuable communities across all channels.

Future Studios is our global content studio and the central engine for video, social, and audio production. We build serialized IP and franchises while developing on-camera talent and creators. Operating across our New York and UK hubs, we treat content as revenue infrastructure. You'll join an innovative environment that powers video content across all our market-leading brands.

**What you'll do**

Reporting to the Executive Director, Studio Operations (Global), you'll keep our studio operations organized, compliant, and efficient. You'll assist with resourcing, traffic coordination, and maintaining operational dashboards for senior management. Daily, you'll use spreadsheets, project management software, and Google Workspace to track budgets, purchase orders, and invoices.

* Maintain studio resourcing trackers, utilization snapshots, and freelance roster databases.
* Help organize studio operating rhythms, including agendas, meeting notes, and action tracking.
* Process freelance onboarding, contract routing, deal memos, and vendor setup.
* Track purchase orders, vendor invoices, and studio operational spending against budgets.
* Coordinate facilities, equipment bookings, and edit suite scheduling for the US hub.
* Route cross-functional Legal, Compliance, Rights, and Licensing requests to right owners.

**What you’ll bring**

* Experience coordinating studio, production, or business operations in a media environment.
* Strong skills in spreadsheets and digital project management systems.
* Written communication skills with experience organizing action items across senior stakeholders.
* Ability to handle confidential budget, contract, and personnel information with discretion.
* Familiarity with vendor onboarding, invoice tracking, and purchase order administration.
* Ability to manage multiple project timelines and deadlines simultaneously.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Experience using spreadsheets and digital project management software for tracking operations.
* Ability to work a hybrid schedule from our New York office.

**What's In It For You**

The expected range for this role is $70,000 - $75,000

As well as more great perks, including:

* Uncapped leave, because we trust you to manage your workload and time
* When we hit our targets, enjoy a share of our profits with a bonus
* Refer a friend and get rewarded when they join Future
* Well-being support with access to our Colleague Assistant Programs
* Opportunity to purchase shares in Future with our Share Incentive Plan

Internal job family level C6

This is a Hybrid role from our New York Office, working 3 days from the office, 2 from home

**Who We Are**

We're Future, the global leader in specialist media. With over 3,000 employees working across 200+ media brands, Future is a prime destination for passionate people worldwide looking to consume trusted, expert content that educates and inspires action - both online and off - through our specialist websites, magazines, events, newsletters, podcasts and social spaces.

We've got ambitious plans that further build on our growth momentum and unlock new opportunities – and we're looking for driven people who want to be a part of it!

Different perspectives spark ideas, fuel creativity, and push us to innovate. We're building a workplace where we value, respect, and empower everyone to thrive.

The Global Business Marketing (GBM) team champions TikTok in the B2B landscape, showing advertisers and sales teams how TikTok's creative ecosystem drives real business results. Working with brands of all sizes, we also bring campaigns to life through creative ideation, brand and event strategy, and the design and production of TikTok for Business marketing, so advertisers can create content that connect with audiences. The challenge is turning what makes the platform engaging into solutions that are creative, measurable, and scalable across very different markets, without making the experience feel like traditional advertising. You will shape how the market understands TikTok as a business platform, and help brands show up authentically on it. new_jobs.title: Head Coach & Community Manager - Downtown Brooklyn, NY
new_jobs.description:
[solidcore] is looking for a Head Coach who is passionate about sharing the [solidcore] brand and workout. Reporting to the Area Manager, the Head Coach is responsible for various tasks that will not only support the Studio and its success, but also support [solidcore] as a company in our mission to be the fastest growing and most successful boutique fitness studio. The Head Coach is expected to role model all of the qualities and attributes of an exceptional coach – the Head Coach is expected to coach an average of ten (10) classes per week. Responsible for delivering a best in class experience, setting the standards for other coaches to aspire to. The Head Coach provides a high level of coach development, giving consistent feedback to their team with the ability to provide support in-studio throughout new coach trainings.

### **You will be responsible for...**

* Serving as the [solidcore] studio’s lead coach, maintaining a full schedule of 10+ classes per week.
* Serving as an example and setting the expectations for new and existing coaches.
* Delivering a best-in-class fitness and customer service experience consistent with [solidcore] standards.
* Meeting company utilization & retention expectations on both an individual level and for the studio as a whole.
* Taking direction from the Area Manager to assist with day-to-day operations of the studio.
* Lead outreach and marketing efforts as necessary to scout new clients and create long-term partnerships in the community.
* Providing coach development to a team of coaches, delivering informal/formal feedback & assisting new coach trainings with in-person support.
* Assisting as needed with responses to client requests and resolving concerns promptly and effectively.
* Maintaining product knowledge for all studio retail operations, including class packages, current promotions, and apparel.
* Executing routine operational tasks including, but not limited to ordering supplies, conducting inventory, and maintaining sales logs.
* Ensuring the studio and equipment remain impeccable and fully-functioning at all times.
* Other duties and projects as assigned and as needed.

### **What we need from you:**

* This is a permanent, exempt, full-time position with an expected 40 hours per week (including classes coached).
* Flexible and variable availability including weekends & holidays with ability to accommodate coach training schedules & the fluctuating needs of the business.
* Ability to lift / carry a minimum of 30 pounds.
* Proficiency in g-Suite and MS office, specifically excel and google sheets.

### **What skills and experience you will bring to us:**

* Optimism and hard work with a love for health, fitness, and the [solidcore] workout.
* Passionate about helping others become the strongest version of themselves and achieve their goals.
* Passionate about building relationships and developing teams, creating an environment that fosters growth.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, people-focused, entrepreneurial environment.
* 1-2 years prior group fitness experience.
* Outgoing and personable with a desire to build relationships within and outside the [solidcore] community.
* Team player with a positive attitude.
* Genuine desire to inspire and motivate others.
* Reliable and professional.
* Comfortable on a mic leading a fast-paced class with loud music and lots of energy in the room.
* Ability to model the [solidcore] brand and culture and serve as a lead representative of the [solidcore] community.
* Superior client relations and communication skills.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

* Compensation Range: $73,917-$82,233 per year
* Flexible PTO
* Full coverage health, dental, & vision insurance
* 401k with employer match
* Cellphone stipend

[solidcore] is a national boutique fitness company with 100+ studios across the country. Our signature workout is 50 minutes of low-impact, high-intensity strength training: the lights are low and the music is loud. The coach guides the class through a series of slow & controlled movements that are sequenced to work muscles to failure. This class is accessible for all fitness levels and can be amplified or modified to accommodate individual goals. Class is as intense as our reviews suggest, but our instructors go above and beyond to provide a welcoming, supportive, empowering, and challenging experience for all. Please visit our website to read more about our mission.

[solidcore] is firmly committed to social justice and promoting a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion. You can visit our website to find out more about the actions we are taking to promote a more diverse and inclusive space for both our clients and our internal team.

[solidcore] is an equal-opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. [solidcore] makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

new_jobs.title: Part-Time Street Team Representative — Field Marketing & Events
new_jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

Join the Street Team. We’re looking for energetic, outgoing, engaging people to support field marketing campaigns for retail locations and consumer brands.

Stonewell Management employs and manages the Street Team. Representatives engage pedestrian traffic, execute approved promotions, and support events that generate awareness, foot traffic, and new customer purchases.

You’ll have opportunities to work independently, in pairs, or in larger groups depending on the assignment. You’ll follow your assigned supervisor’s direction, use approved promotional materials, and help turn direct engagement into measurable results.

The ideal candidate is approachable, adaptable, self-directed, reliable, and comfortable initiating conversations with strangers while following company guidelines and applicable compliance requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Engage pedestrian traffic around assigned retail locations and explain approved promotions to encourage foot traffic.
* Execute field marketing activations at storefronts, events, conventions, and other approved locations.
* Support approved outreach to nearby businesses and hospitality partners.
* Know the current weekly promotions, approved featured-product facts, assigned locations, and campaign objectives before each shift.
* Direct customers to store staff for product selection and recommendations.
* Use approved QR codes, promotional codes, and other tracking tools to support measurable customer acquisition.
* Report assignment results, customer feedback, useful local opportunities, and problems to your assigned supervisor.
* Support photography, video, and social content capture when assigned, following company consent guidelines.
* Work effectively on individual and group assignments.
* Represent the assigned client or campaign professionally and follow company policies and applicable industry regulations.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in street promotions, field marketing, events, community outreach, nightlife, or brand representation preferred. Hospitality, retail, or sales experience is also relevant.
* Strong interpersonal skills and confidence initiating conversations with strangers.
* Comfortable engaging pedestrians and approaching local businesses.
* Reliable, adaptable, self-directed, and coachable.
* Able to follow an assignment brief, work within approved boundaries, and report results.
* Familiarity with NYC neighborhoods, hospitality, nightlife, and local business communities is highly valued.
* Cannabis product and industry knowledge preferred.
* Must be at least 21 years old and authorized to work in New York State.
* Flexible availability, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and special events.
* Ability to travel throughout the NYC metro area as needed.

**Schedule and Team Structure**

This is a part-time role with variable hours. Weekly hours may range from a few hours to 20 or more, depending on campaign needs, scheduled activations, and your availability. A consistent weekly schedule is not guaranteed.

You’ll be part of the Street Team, with assignments coordinated around client priorities, events, and team availability. Assignments may be completed individually, with a partner, or as part of a larger group.

**Success in This Role Looks Like**

You arrive prepared and know the current weekly promotions. You turn outreach into new customer visits and purchases, execute assignments reliably, use tracking tools accurately, and provide useful feedback to your supervisor. You contribute effectively both independently and alongside other Street Team members.

**Pay:** $24.00–$30.00 per hour  
**Work Location:** In person

**SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER**

**NEW YORK CITY, USA**

Hybrid Working - 3 days in the office per week. We operate a Fix + Flex model, with Wednesdays and Thursdays as our two Fix Days, when everyone is in the office, and the third day is Flex across Monday, Tuesday, and Friday.

A benchmarked salary between **$80,000 - $90,000** based on your level within our progression framework. Where an employee or prospective employee is paid within this range will depend on, among other factors, actual ranges for current/former employees in the subject position, market considerations, budgetary considerations, tenure and standing with the Company (applicable to current employees), as well as the employee’s/applicant’s skill set, level of experience, and qualifications.

**WHO WE ARE**  
We are Born Social, a social-first creative agency that brings brand building into the social era. We have a track record of delivering transformation for iconic brands like Guinness, Ford, and Barclays, led by our team of social natives and brand experts, underpinned by technology.

Backed by the strength of a brilliant business that's proudly B-Corp certified, we're consistently recognized as one of the best places to work.

We're part of Croud, a global, full-service digital marketing business. Today, Croud and Born Social bring together distinct creative and performance specialisms. We’re now entering the next stage of our journey: becoming a more integrated business, with shared functions and ways of working, while protecting the specialist expertise that makes each part brilliant.

Excitingly, we have just won our first integrated retainer in the States with a non-profit movement launched for the country's 250th anniversary in 2026 to reignite genuine community contribution. This work reflects our values as a business, and we're looking for passionate people to bring it to life.

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**

* Lo-Fi content creation: Creating and editing native lo-fi assets (both meme and video formats) across Instagram Reels, Instagram Stories, TikTok, ensuring the content complies with best practice for each platform.
* Culture Scouting: Looking for reactive opportunities in community and culture and ideating the best ways for our clients to enter those moments in real-time.
* Community Management: Monitoring and responding to the messages we receive from our communities, as well as identifying proactive opportunities beyond our tagged mentions to engage with new audiences. Crafting social-first replies through relevant copy and creative tactics.
* Ideation: Pairing knowledge of social-first trends and audience insights with brand knowledge and tone of voice to ideate content, across all formats from written to visual responses.
* Copywriting: acting as the voice across the brand channels, writing copy across community responses as well as for captions on our social posts
* Reporting: Evaluating the organic performance of our content for our clients, sharing valuable insights and creative analysis to drive forward the iteration of our strategies and output delivery.
* Collaboration & Communication: Working in a nimble and collaborative environment, you will work closely with our Strategy, Creative, and Client Services teams to ensure we are delivering leading social-first delivery for our clients, ideating and communicating regularly.

**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* A creative, social native: You are well versed across the key social platforms, with experience of creating and editing your own native lo-fi content (TikTok & Reels)
* You are immersed in social and popular culture: The "chronically online" friend in the group, regularly keeping up to date with the latest social trends across platforms and in popular culture.
* You are quick-witted, and have a flair for comedic community management, able to "speak the internet" with a strong understanding of social in-jokes and language.
* You enjoy working fast: You enjoy thinking on your feet, moving fast to adapt and react to the latest daily trends. The role is best suited to someone who thrives in an agile and fast-paced environment, with plenty of variety every day.
* You are collaborative: This team requires all hands on deck, with lots of in-person communication and collaboration.
* Pride in your work: we treat our client's brands as our own and are meticulous about our approach. You will take real pride in what you deliver and always strive for perfection
* Real drive and ambition: you'll be constantly adapting to the ever-growing world of social, and have the mindset of growth as well as the ambition to get there
* You'll have two or more years of experience working with social media (agency-side preferable)

**NO GRIT NO PEARL**

No Grit No Pearl is our creative mantra – a single-minded statement of intent that defines how we get to great work and the standard we hold ourselves to. Because we believe the best work isn't formed instantly, they're shaped through commitment, care, and perseverance. Grit isn’t about grind - it’s about staying curious, pushing ideas, and appreciating the process to reach the Pearl - work we’re proud of, created to the highest standard that makes a lasting impact.

**VALUES**

Our values aim to pinpoint the magic ingredients for us at our best. We look for people who share our values and can add to our culture.

new_jobs.title: Digital Marketing Intern, Accounts
new_jobs.description:
Hudson Creative is seeking a Digital Marketing Intern to join our team as part of a 4-month training program designed to teach, mentor, and prepare outstanding interns for a full-time role and career path. This internship is intended for recent college graduates (or soon-to-be graduates) with less than 1 year of relevant digital marketing experience who are excited for practical training and development by our amazing team. This role is a great opportunity for both analytically-minded and creatively-driven candidates who are interested in how paid ads, SEO, social media, email marketing, and visual storytelling intersect in the restaurant and hospitality industries.

**Quick Facts:**

* Internship Period: 4 months starting October 2026 (flexible start and end dates)
* Location: NYC
* Work policy: Hybrid with 3 days per week onsite at our midtown office (Grand Central)
* Hours: Full-Time (9:00am - 5:30pm EST)
* Compensation: $2,200/month stipend
* Mentorship: Daily progress check-ins with your manager to ensure growth and successful completion of the internship
* Reports to: Digital Marketing Director

**What You’ll Do & Learn** You’ll support real client work and get hands-on exposure across key areas of digital marketing:

**Paid Media**

* Learn how to set up and support paid campaigns (Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, etc.)
* Assist with campaign monitoring, pacing, and performance reporting
* Gain exposure to optimization strategies and data-driven decision making

**SEO & Website Support**

* Assist with keyword research and on-page optimizations
* Support local listing updates across Google, Yelp, Apple, and other platforms
* Assist with citation management and submissions through BrightLocal
* Support website updates across platforms like WordPress, Shopify, Squarespace, and BentoBox
* Help QA website updates to ensure accuracy, functionality, and proper tracking

**Reporting & Analytics**

* Assist with recurring performance reporting and dashboard updates
* Help analyze campaign and website performance to identify trends and insights
* Gain exposure to GA4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, and Google Sheets
* Support tracking QA and validation to ensure accurate reporting

**Client Experience & Strategy**

* Join internal and external meetings to observe strategy development
* Participate in discussions on trends, optimizations, and campaign planning
* Contribute ideas in a collaborative, supportive environment

**Who You Are:**

* Rising seniors or new graduates who recently finished their degree in advertising, marketing, business administration, communications or related field
* Passion for advertising and the hospitality industry
* Interest in performance marketing, analytics, SEO, or digital advertising
* Excellent time management and organizational skills
* Strong attention to detail, especially when handling data or website updates
* A team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is ready to contribute and learn
* Familiarity with tools like Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics, or SEO platforms is a plus
* Comfort working with data in Excel/Google Sheets
* Prior experience or interest in the restaurant and hospitality industry is a plus

**Why This Internship?**

* A structured, supportive learning environment
* Exposure to multiple digital channels to find your strengths and interests
* Real work for hospitality brands and hands-on training with our senior team
* A clear development path with potential for full-time placement

**Perks:**

* Company issued Apple laptop for your day-to-day productivity
* Flexible hybrid work policy with convenient office location near Grand Central Station
* Team events including happy hours and quarterly wellness activities
* Cold brew, coffee, tea and kombucha on tap, as well as office snacks for the midday pick-me-up
* Exposure to a wide network of hospitality and industry partners
* Growth-oriented culture with room to take on responsibility quickly

**Interview Process:** Jumpstart your career at www.hudsoncreative.com/careers. Please include both a resume and cover letter for consideration.

* Round 1: Video interview with our hiring manager to discuss your digital marketing and career interests.
* Round 2: Live practical marketing exercise to apply your understanding and skillset
* Round 3: Video interview with a member of our marketing team to share your analysis and strategic approach.
* Round 4: On-site interview with our account director.

**About Us:** Hudson Creative is a data-driven digital marketing agency that specializes in the design, strategy and execution of campaigns to help brands grow online. Our clients include widely recognized industry leaders, and range from multi-location restaurant groups and F&B brands, to law firms and tourism boards, and beyond. Our experienced team has a strong passion for driving meaningful results that make game-changing business impacts for clients.

Pay: $2,200.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10017

new_jobs.title: TERRITORY MEDICAL SALES REPRESENTATIVE & MICRONJET™ PRODUCT SPECIALIST NEW YORK/NEW JERSEY
new_jobs.description:
**TERRITORY MEDICAL SALES REPRESENTATIVE & MICRONJET™ PRODUCT SPECIALIST**

**NEW YORK/NEW JERSEY**

**Companies:** NextMDLink, its affiliates, and NanoPass Technologies

**Location:** Remote/Field-Based; Northern New Jersey or Greater New York Metropolitan Area Preferred

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

NextMDLink, its affiliates, and NanoPass Technologies are seeking a motivated, results-driven Territory Medical Sales Representative & MicronJet™ Product Specialist to launch and grow MicronJet, NanoPass’s FDA-cleared intradermal delivery platform, throughout New York and New Jersey.

This is a field-based medical sales position focused on new-account acquisition, market penetration and recurring revenue. The representative will prospect for new business, develop relationships with cosmetic dermatology, plastic surgery and medical-aesthetic practices, conduct product demonstrations and manage accounts from the initial sale through continued utilization and reorders.

The representative will enter the territory with a fairly new established foundation, supporting the MicronJet rollout across more than 90 locations within one of the country’s largest dermatology organizations. The representative will also develop additional accounts and cross-sell products from the broader NextMD regenerative and aesthetic portfolio.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Prospect for and open new cosmetic dermatology, plastic surgery and medical-aesthetic accounts throughout New York and New Jersey.
* Build and manage a qualified sales pipeline through field visits, telephone outreach, referrals, networking and industry events.
* Develop relationships with physicians, practice owners, medical directors and purchasing decision-makers.
* Conduct sales presentations, product evaluations and in-person demonstrations.
* Manage the sales process from initial outreach through closing, onboarding and account growth.
* Support the MicronJet rollout across more than 90 established dermatology locations.
* Provide product onboarding and practitioner training after completing company-provided education.
* Monitor utilization and reorder activity to support retention and recurring revenue.
* Expand established accounts by developing additional providers and identifying cross-selling opportunities.
* Represent the broader NextMD portfolio of regenerative, aesthetic and delivery products.
* Create and execute an organized territory sales plan.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, pipeline information and sales forecasts.
* Represent MicronJet, NextMDLink, its affiliates, and NanoPass at meetings, conferences and industry events.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Demonstrated sales, prospecting, relationship-building or business-development ability.
* Strong communication, presentation, organization and follow-up skills.

GME Supply is seeking a driven and relationship-focused **Government Account Manager** with experience in industrial distribution, government procurement, and transactional B2B sales. This role is ideal for someone who understands how to navigate government buying channels and has experience working with or selling to government organizations.

You will manage and grow a portfolio of government accounts while developing new business opportunities within the public sector industrial supply space, competing in similar markets.

This is a high-activity, transactional sales role focused on responsiveness, account penetration, and consistent execution.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Account Growth & Management**

* Manage and grow assigned government and public sector accounts, state agencies, and municipal organizations
* Identify new opportunities within existing accounts and expand product penetration across MRO and safety supply categories
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of transactional and recurring supply opportunities

**Government Sales & Procurement Navigation**

* Work within government procurement frameworks including GSA schedules, TAA compliance, SLED/SLEA environments, and federal contracting requirements
* Understand and support purchasing workflows such as purchase orders, credit card (GPC) buying, and bid-based procurement processes
* Ensure compliance with all applicable government purchasing and contract regulations

**Sales Execution**

* Execute pricing, quoting, and order management in alignment with company guidelines
* Use a structured sales process to identify needs, overcome objections, and close opportunities efficiently
* Maintain accurate pipeline forecasting and account activity tracking
* Represent Columbia Safety and Supply at relevant industry or government-related events when applicable

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

**Required Skills**

* 2–4+ years of experience in industrial distribution, MRO sales, government contracting, or transactional outside sales
* Familiarity with government procurement processes (GSA, TAA compliance, SLED, or military base purchasing systems)
* Experience working with or selling into public sector accounts (federal, state, local, or military)

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of safety supply, PPE, MRO, or industrial consumables
* Experience with CRM systems and pipeline management tools

  

### **Why it's great to build your career with us!**

We are a tight-knit group, and we understand the needs of our teammates. This personal connection allows us to strategically design competitive benefits packages that enhance the employee experience and support overall well-being.

Some of our benefits:

* Health, Vision & Dental Insurance with company contributions
* Free Employee Assistance Program: 24/7 access
* Generous paid time off (PTO) that increases with tenure
* Paid holidays
* Volunteer Paid Time Off: Give back to our community & get paid!
* 401k Matching Options with no Vesting Requirements

Applications are being taken exclusively online for this role, we look forward to learning about the ways that your talents will support the growth and vision of our organization!

*This job description is not intended to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.*

*The GMES family of companies provides to individuals of all races, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital, and veteran status, equal employment opportunities within our dynamic growth plans.*

### **About GME Supply**

The GME Supply family of companies is a group of brands that focus on industrial distribution related to safety equipment, tools, and gear for at-height industries and commercial users. Our success is fueled by a tenacious team and headquartered in the United States, with locations strategically throughout North America.

We are a high-reaching group of industry professionals focusing our energies on staying ahead for the competitive markets we serve. We train our employees to be Gear ExpertsⓇ that provide solutions to industry experts, and we partner with some of the most recognized brands on the planet.

Strong connections between teammates in our business allows dedication to our mission and supports each employee’s personal goals. Coupling internal development with the recruitment of external candidates means we always have the most talented and diverse team possible. We believe that combining diverse talents and backgrounds to create an inclusive and successful work community is the key to long-term success.

If you are looking to be part of a structured and motivated team where you are valued for the quality work you provide, our family of companies is the right group for you!

Applications are being taken exclusively online for this role, we look forward to learning about the ways that we may work together and how your talents will contribute to the vision of our organization!

* Identify and develop new business opportunities through proactive prospecting and relationship building.
* Own the full sales cycle from discovery to close and project execution.
* Build and manage long-term client relationships across multiple industries (multifamily, restoration, commercial, etc.).

**What We’re Looking For**

* Experience in business development, outside sales, or account management.
* Strong consultative selling and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and opportunities simultaneously.
* Self-motivated with a results-driven mindset.
* Experience in flooring, construction, restoration, or related industries is a plus.

**Compensation & Earning Potential**

* $70,000 Base salary + proven commission structure.
* Multiple six-figure earning opportunities through commissions and bonus incentives.
* Uncapped earning potential tied directly to performance.

**Perks & Amenities**

* Car allowance + mileage reimbursement.
* Company-provided cell phone and tablet.
* Per diem opportunities for travel and business development activities.
* Comprehensive support and resources to help you succeed in the field.

**Why Join E4B**

* Backed by a nationally recognized brand with strong market presence.
* Opportunity to build a long-term book of business and grow your career.
* Collaborative, high-performance culture focused on results and development.
* Streamlined hiring process designed to move quickly and efficiently.

**Why Empire Today?**

**We empower our employees to strive for their unique goals.** Within such an inclusive company with unlimited growth opportunities, how far you go is up to you.

new_jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
As a Sales Development Representative you will be a key contributor to our enterprise wide sales initiative. We are looking for someone with a proven track record and hunger for success in our industry. The goal is to drive sustainable financial growth through boosting sales and forging lasting relationships with our customers.

**What You’ll Do:**

* As the Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will take ownership of nurturing and cultivating relationships with our prospects throughout their entire journey, from initial contact to post-sale support. Your pivotal role involves creating a well-structured sales funnel through proactive prospecting, ensuring a steady flow of activity and opportunities for our sales team.
* Employ various strategies to generate appointments and drive traffic by meeting departmental activity targets utilizing outbound calls, online inquiries, and other lead-generation techniques.
* Effectively communicate with prospective customers to understand their needs, answer inquiries, and provide information about our RV products and services.
* Utilize provided scripts and talking points for both initiating and receiving phone calls.
* Proactively make 8-10 outbound calls per hour with the primary objective of scheduling sales appointments.
* Utilize the CRM system to record and manage customer information, appointments, calls, and sales interactions. Maintaining accurate and up-to-date data is essential for efficient follow-up and tracking.
* Stay up-to-date with all ongoing marketing campaigns and promotions. Align your efforts with marketing initiatives to leverage their impact on lead generation and sales conversion.
* Regularly track and analyze your personal performance metrics, including appointments scheduled, calls made, sales achieved, and customer engagements.
* Be receptive to coaching and work closely with the Sales Development Manager to improve departmental success.
* Ensure complete customer satisfaction by helping to proactively manage online reputation through review sites and social media outlets.
* Collaborate with sales team to ensure total department symbiosis and ensure a seamless journey from initial contact to sale.
* VinSolutions experience is a huge plus!

**What You Need to Have for the Role:**

* Clear and concise written and verbal communication
* Results driven and motivated for sales
* Excellent customer service
* Effectively manages responsibilities with time management to reach goals
* Ability to multi-task while demonstrating strong organizational skills
* Has prior CRM experience and is very computer savvy
* Previous sales experience a plus
* May lift up to 25 lbs and/or move up to 50 lbs. with assistive devices

**General Compensation Disclosure**

The pay range for this role considers several factors in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the factors stated. A reasonable estimate of the total annual compensation range (base pay + variable compensation earned) is $35,000 - $55,000 or more. This is a variable pay role with uncapped variable pay.

In addition to competitive pay, we offer Paid Time Off, 401(k), an Employee Assistance Program, Good Sam Roadside Assistance, discounts, paid parental leave (if eligibility is met), Tuition Reimbursement (if eligibility is met), and on the job training opportunities. Full-time associates are offered a comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental, vision and more! Part-time associates are offered access to dental & vision coverage! For more information please visit: www.mycampingworldbenefits.com

We are an equal employment opportunity employer. The Company's policy is not to discriminate against any applicant or employee based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age (40 and over), disability, veteran or uniformed service-member status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

The Sales Operations Intern will support the daily operations of the sales organization by assisting with analytics, reporting, process optimization, and tool management. This role is ideal for a student interested in sales strategy, business operations, or revenue analytics. The intern will gain hands-on experience working with cross-functional teams, analyzing sales performance metrics, and improving operational efficiency to help drive organizational growth.

* Assist in preparing weekly and monthly sales reports, dashboards, and performance summaries.
* Track KPIs such as pipeline activity, conversion rates, and sales productivity.
* Monitor data accuracy and help resolve data discrepancies within CRM systems.

* Support documentation and standardization of sales processes.

* Assist with CRM data entry, updates, and system maintenance (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar).

* Help troubleshoot basic user issues related to sales tools and platforms.

* Current student pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Data Analytics, Finance, or a related field.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and generate insights.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; familiarity with PowerPoint and Word.
* Exposure to CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) is a plus but not required.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Self-motivated, eager to learn, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.

  

**What You’ll Gain**

* Experience working on real sales processes and tools used in modern revenue organizations.
* Exposure to sales strategy, forecasting, and pipeline management.

* Opportunity to collaborate with leaders across the company.
* Hands-on experience that supports future roles in sales operations, revenue operations, business analytics, or sales strategy.

Our financial excellence, amazing people, and powerful partnerships build outstanding outcomes and peace of mind for our agents and their clients. This is what we mean by Insurance Built Strong®.

new_jobs.title: Business Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
Aderant is a global industry leading software company providing comprehensive business management solutions for law firms and other professional services organizations with a mission to help them run a better business. We are motivated by a collective desire to drive the legal industry to the forefront of innovation. With over 2,500 clients around the world, including 95 of the top AmLaw 100 firms, we are changing the outside perception of the legal sphere; where there was once resistance to modernization, we are creating a culture that embraces new ideas and technology.

At Aderant, the “A” is more than just a letter. It is a representation of how we fulfill our foundational purpose, serving our clients. It embodies our core values and reminds us that to achieve success, every day must start with the “A”. We bring the “A” to life by fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and personal growth. We encourage our diverse teams to bring their whole selves to work – ideas, experience, and passion – to drive our mission forward.

Our people are our strength.

**Role Description:**

To be successful in this role, you should have experience qualifying inbound leads from marketing campaigns and converting high-intent interest into qualified sales opportunities. You will serve as the first point of contact for prospective customers who request demos or engage with Aderant’s marketing programs, ensuring a timely , consultative, and high-quality response.

You will collaborate closely with Aderant’s Marketing and Sales teams to ensure seamless handoff of Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) into Sales Qualified Opportunities (SQOs), maintaining alignment on qualification criteria, messaging, and pipeline goals. If you are motivated, organized, and thrive in a fast-paced environment with high lead volume, we’d like to meet you.

This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about leveraging AI tools and automation to manage inbound volume efficiently, prioritize leads intelligently, and personalize engagement at scale.

**Responsibilities:**

* Qualify inbound Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs), including demo requests and high-intent inquiries, into Sales Qualified Opportunities (SQOs).

* Manage and respond promptly to incoming demo requests and marketing-generated leads to ensure strong speed-to-lead performance.

* Conduct discovery conversations to understand prospect needs, challenges, timeline, budget, and decision-making process .

* Assess fit and determine alignment with Aderant’s products and services.

* Schedule qualified opportunities for Account Executives and ensure thorough handoff with clear context and documentation.

* Partner closely with Marketing to provide feedback on lead quality, campaign performance, and messaging effectiveness.

* Collaborate with Sales teams to align on qualification standards, target accounts, and pipeline priorities.

* Leverage AI tools and automation to prioritize inbound leads, streamline follow-up workflows, improve data accuracy, and personalize engagement — with a passion for experimenting and learning how AI can elevate performance.

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date prospect data in Salesforce and marketing automation platforms.

* Stay current on Aderant’s product offerings, services, and pricing/payment plans.

* Regularly report on lead conversion metrics, response times, and pipeline contribution to Sales and Marketing leadership.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing , Business Administration, or related field.

* At least one year of professional experience.

* Proven work experience as a Business Development Representative or similar role with a track record of achieving sales quotas.

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple inbound inquiries while meeting or exceeding conversion targets.

* Excellent communication skills include phone, writing, and listening.

* Self-starter who has a desire to learn, grow, and excel in their role.

* Experience with Marketo and Salesforce.

* Understanding of the legal industry and/or SaaS technology.

Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

The Salesforce Project Coordinator will help teams plan and execute the vision for our clients through transformative technologies to solve real-world business problems with sound business principles. This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. The Senior Project Manager will manage the end-to-end execution of projects with internal creative and development teams to deliver tangible value.  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
* Manage day-to-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables
* Maintain prompt, proactive, and transparent communication with the client to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to effectively drive project delivery
* Lead team and client meetings, ensuring timely follow-up and holding project team members accountable
* Provide daily task coordination, action tracking and project evaluation
* Leverage data to measure and monitor progress against commitments and provide transparency to project team
* Coach clients on Agile practices and champion the right Agile frameworks based on the type of work
* Use effective decision making to control risk and minimize uncertainty while being proactive through strategic thinking to strive to find new and innovative ways to deliver successful results
* Implement streamlined, effective processes through change management
* Mentor and train entry level team members; play a key role in the interviewing and onboarding process for new Project Managers
* Operate as an innovative thought leader; contribute significantly to the overall growth and quality of the department through knowledge sharing and coaching on current best practices and market trends

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in technology-focused project management
* Minimum of 1-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects
* Experience managing and forecasting budgets
* Ability to provide attention to detail and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
* Experience creating and maintaining a project plan from inception through completion
* Demonstrated success in leading multiple enterprise strategic projects from end-to-end
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to C-Level management
* Excellent organizational, multi-tasking, facilitation, and time management skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills; able to maintain solid rapport through the various working styles of team members as well as clients
* Ability to collaborate and apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills as required
* We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening.
* Bachelor’s degree

**Program Coordinator**

**Chicago Heights Park District | Full-Time Position**

**Position Summary**

The Program Coordinator oversees the planning, implementation, evaluation, and expansion of recreation programs, summer camps, special events, trips, and community activities. This position supports quality recreational services, customer satisfaction, staff development, and efficient department operations while using participation data and community feedback to guide programming decisions.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Plan, coordinate, implement, and evaluate seasonal recreation programs, sports, special events, community activities, and trips.
* Research community needs and recommend new programs, services, schedules, and fees.
* Recruit, train, supervise, and evaluate instructors, program staff, and summer camp personnel, with hiring subject to Superintendent approval.
* Manage summer camp operations, including curriculum, staffing, field trips, safety compliance, and Summer Food Program documentation.
* Administer recreational software, including program setup, seasonal schedules, enrollment tracking, and reporting.
* Monitor program participation, customer satisfaction, and financial performance to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Collaborate with the Special Events Coordinator, marketing personnel, and external vendors to coordinate promotional activities and seasonal digital program booklets and social media material.
* Provide accurate program information for social media, website updates, digital announcements, television displays, and marketing materials.
* Coordinate program logistics, timelines, staffing plans, and communication across departments.
* Support the Park District’s Master Plan goals through organized programming, data analysis, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications & Credentials**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Minimum of two years of experience in recreation programming, event coordination, program administration, or a related field.
* Associate or bachelor’s degree in Recreation Administration, Parks and Recreation Management, Sports Management, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
* Strong organizational, communication, leadership, and customer service skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
* Experience with staff supervision, summer camps, special events, program budgeting, and enrollment reporting preferred.
* CPR, First Aid, and AED certification preferred, or willingness to obtain certification.
* Ability to work occasional evenings, weekends, and special events.
* Successful completion of applicable background checks required.

**Work Environment**

The Program Coordinator works in a community recreation setting and collaborates with staff, instructors, community partners, and contracted marketing professionals to deliver effective and engaging recreational services.

Pay: $50,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Entry Level Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
US Energy is an Energy Brokerage firm based in the Chicago land area. US Energy specializes in Brokering Energy and offering Energy Supply initiatives for Business Class Customers in the state of Illinois. We are opening 5 more national offices by the end of 2027- each will be run by an executive who started in our entry level account manager position and progressed through our training into management. We find that candidates with sports backgrounds have valuable skill sets due to their work ethic, competitive drive, and ability to win in all types of situations.

This is a hands-on opportunity for someone who is competitive, driven, personable, and eager to learn. While sales is at the core of the position, our team members gain exposure to campaign management, recruiting, human resources, leadership, and team development.

If you’re someone who enjoys a fast-paced environment, thrives on goals, and wants a clear path for growth, this could be the opportunity for you. We believe in promoting from within. Our goal is to develop talented people into successful sales professionals and future leaders.

**Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity for career advancement within a growing company.
* Comprehensive training and professional development programs.
* Supportive and energetic team environment.
* Competitive compensation and performance-based bonuses.
* Exposure to leadership and strategic business planning.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients.
* Execute effective sales strategies to achieve revenue targets and expand market share.
* Negotiate contracts and agreements with clients to ensure mutual satisfaction.
* Collaborate with team members to create innovative marketing campaigns that drive engagement.
Stay informed about industry trends and competitor activities to identify new opportunities.  

  
  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in sales, marketing, business, or a related field
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Competitive, motivated, and results-oriented mindset
* Ability to build relationships and communicate confidently with clients
* Strong organizational and time-management skills
* Ability to work independently while contributing to a team
* Willingness to commute to our Schaumburg office
* Previous leadership, management, sales, or recruiting experience is a plus

  
**Benefits**  

* Performance-based bonuses
* Leadership incentives
* Dental insurance
* Blue Cross Blue Shield health insurance available
* Paid training and professional development
* Opportunities for advancement

Illinois: $54,400 - $68,000 ($64,000 - $80,000 OTE range)

new_jobs.title: Direct Sales Representative (B2B Sales) - Schaumburg, IL
new_jobs.description:
**Turn Your People Skills Into a Career**

Looking for a career where your attitude, work ethic, and people skills matter more than your previous experience?

**Universal Energy Solutions** is hiring motivated individuals to join our **Schaumburg** team as **Direct Sales Representatives**. Whether you’re just starting your career, changing industries, or looking for a fresh opportunity, this **entry-level** position is designed for people who enjoy working with others and want to build a successful career.

**No previous sales experience? No problem.**

As a **Direct Sales Representative**, you’ll work directly with local business owners to review their electricity and natural gas supply plans, introduce competitive supplier options, and recommend solutions that fit their business needs. During your first several weeks, you’ll focus on developing new business opportunities while learning our proven sales system alongside experienced Account Managers. Their sole focus is to help our newest team members hit the ground running.

**Why This Is a Great Place to Start Your Career**

Many companies expect you to have experience before they’ll give you an opportunity. We believe great sales professionals are developed through training, coaching, and hands-on experience.

During your first several weeks, you’ll work be mentored by an experienced Account Managers who will teach you our proven sales system that’s helped many of our team members build successful careers. You'll get to learn firsthand, what success looks like as you build confidence in your presentations skills and become an expert in our products and services.

As you gain experience, you’ll have opportunities to take on larger customer portfolios, build long-term client relationships, and advance into **Account Manager** and other leadership positions. We’re committed to promoting from within as part of our goal to continually expand into 20+ additional markets over the next few years.

**What You’ll Do**

Your day begins at the office, where you'll work with your mentor to plan, prepare and strategize for the day ahead. You'll then head into your assigned territory and crush your goals. From there, you control the tone and outcome of your day. Responsibilities include:

* Meet face-to-face with business owners and decision-makers.
* Review current electricity and natural gas supply plans.
* Help businesses identify opportunities to reduce their energy costs.
* Recommend competitive energy supplier options based on each customer’s needs.
* Build relationships with prospective commercial customers.
* Learn our proven customer consultation process alongside experienced mentors.
* Travel throughout an assigned territory (typically within a 30-mile radius of the office).

Build the skills needed to take on larger customer portfolios and advance your career.

**Is This a Good Fit for You?**

This role is perfect for people who enjoy working with others, solving problems, and helping businesses make informed decisions. Many of our top performers started in restaurants, retail, hospitality, customer service, athletics, or other customer-facing roles where they learned how to communicate, solve problems, and build relationships. If you’re competitive, coachable, self-motivated, and willing to learn, we’ll provide the training and support to help you succeed.

**Compensation**

**Base Pay + Commission**

* Weekly base pay while you learn the role and build confidence
* Commission earned on new accounts
* Increased earning potential based on performance

**Typical first-year on-target earnings (OTE) range from $55,000–$70,000, with the potential to earn $100,000+ for those who consistently exceed performance goals.**

**Paid Training & Career Development**

Every new hire begins with **paid training and hands-on mentorship**, giving you the opportunity to learn the process, strengthen your product knowledge, and build confidence in your new skills. And the learning doesn’t stop once you’re up and running. As you advance, you’ll have access to continued development in **leadership, business management, and financial skills** designed to prepare you for greater responsibility and opportunity.

Our goal isn’t simply to help you succeed with your first customer—it’s to help you develop the skills to **build a career and continue growing within it**.

**About Universal Energy Solutions**

Universal Energy Solutions helps businesses reduce their energy costs by connecting them with competitive electricity and natural gas supplier programs. **UES Careers** is the recruiting arm of Universal Energy Solutions, supporting hiring across our growing nationwide network of independently owned and operated offices.

 **Requirements**

**Required**

* Valid driver’s license
* Reliable personal vehicle
* Authorized to work in the United States
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Comfortable meeting with business owners face-to-face

**Preferred**

* Previous experience in sales, customer service, retail, hospitality, or another customer-facing role
* Self-motivated with strong communication and organizational skills

  
**Benefits**

**Compensation & Incentives**

* Multiple compensation paths designed to support your career goals
* Paid training
* Commission paid weekly
* Additional performance-based incentives and bonuses

**Career Development**

* Hands-on training from experienced mentors
* Ongoing career coaching
* Career path to Account Manager and leadership positions
* Promote-from-within culture

**Additional Benefits**

* Health benefits after eligibility requirements are met
* Team-oriented work environment

The **Executive Assistant (EA)** provides high‑level administrative, operational, and strategic support to a Senior Vice President (SVP) of our flexible Generation department. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to anticipate needs. The ideal candidate is a trusted partner and advisor who thrives in a fast‑paced environment, can manage multiple priorities simultaneously, able to work without guidance, and is comfortable representing the SVP in day‑to‑day communications.

* Manage executive calendar, meeting, event, and follow-up activities for the SVP, including scheduling, prioritizing requests, coordinating across stakeholders and time zones, preparing materials, capturing minutes or action logs as needed, and ensuring commitments are completed on time
* Provide high-level administrative support including document assimilation, preparation, and quality assurance

* Serve as a trusted partner and advisor to the SVP, proactively managing priorities and anticipating needs
* Act as point of contact for administration issues and escalating as appropriate
* Liaise and provide support to other RWE Assistants, providing coverage for other Executive Assistants when needed
* Plan and book all SVP business travel including preparation of all necessary forms and documents
* Prepare and submit travel and business expense reports accurately and on time
* Monitor and help manage the SVP’s inbox with discretion, identifying priorities, drafting or sending routine responses as authorized, flagging urgent matters, and escalating sensitive or high-impact issues appropriately
* Support HR leadership routines and confidential people-related processes by preparing materials, coordinating follow-ups, maintaining discretion with sensitive employee, compensation, organizational, and employee relations information, and escalating sensitive matters appropriately

* Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment, maintain discretion, and handle highly confidential information appropriately
* Preferred: demonstrated executive presence and sound judgment when interacting with senior leaders, employees, external partners, and confidential stakeholders
* Proven demonstration of analytical and problem solving skills
* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office products including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and SharePoint
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written
* Ability to quickly learn new technology programs
* Able to work independently and as part of a team
* Strong organizational, time management, and multitasking skills
* Critical thinking and problem-solving skills
* High level of attention to detail and follow‑through

new_jobs.title: Social Media Manager – Prop Trading
new_jobs.description:
ThinkMarkets is a global financial technology company specializing in multi-asset trading solutions. Through our flagship ThinkTrader platform, we provide clients worldwide with access to thousands of financial instruments across global markets, supported by advanced trading technology and infrastructure.

Backed by ThinkMarkets' market expertise and infrastructure, ThinkCapital is our prop trading evaluation business, providing aspiring traders with access to a broad range of trading products within a simulated trading environment.

Our mission is to simplify the trading journey by combining smart technology with trusted support, giving traders the tools, education and opportunities to develop their skills and elevate their trading potential.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a creative, hands-on Social Media Manager to grow ThinkCapital's social presence, engage trader audiences and build an active online community.

You will plan, create and publish content, manage daily audience interactions and use performance insights to improve results. The role combines social media execution with an understanding of prop trading, trader interests and the content that builds awareness, trust and interest in our evaluation products.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Social Media & Content**

* Plan and execute social media activity across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Facebook, LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.
* Manage the content calendar, aligning posts with product updates, campaigns, promotions and relevant trading themes.
* Create engaging content, including captions, short-form videos, educational posts and community-led content.
* Work with Creative and Marketing teams to produce platform-specific visuals, reels and videos.
* Translate challenge features, evaluation rules and product benefits into clear, accessible content.
* Test new content formats and respond to relevant trends while maintaining a consistent brand voice.

**Community & Engagement**

* Manage daily audience interactions, responding to comments and messages and coordinating customer queries with Support.
* Build and engage trader communities across social platforms and owned channels such as Discord.
* Encourage conversations, gather feedback and identify opportunities for community participation.
* Support collaborations with relevant trading creators, influencers and brand ambassadors.
* Monitor audience sentiment and flag recurring questions or concerns to the relevant teams.

**Performance & Collaboration**

* Track audience growth, engagement, reach, website traffic and conversions from social activity.
* Use performance insights to improve content, publishing schedules and community engagement.
* Monitor competitor activity, trader conversations and platform trends to identify new opportunities.
* Work with Marketing, Product and Support teams on campaigns, launches and community initiatives.
* Ensure content accurately reflects ThinkCapital's products and follows brand, platform and internal approval guidelines.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism or a related field from a recognized, accredited university.
* Hands-on experience managing social channels and creating engaging content.
* Familiarity with short-form video formats, including TikTok, Reels and YouTube Shorts.
* Strong writing skills and the ability to adapt content for different platforms.
* Understanding of audience engagement, community management and social media analytics.
* Interest in prop trading and an understanding of trader audiences and evaluation programs.
* Experience in prop trading, fintech or trading-related marketing is a plus.
* Experience with Discord, creator collaborations or social media management tools is a plus.
* Examples of content, campaigns or social channels you have worked on.

As an Arborist Representative, you will play an integral role in helping grow our business by developing and maintaining long-term client relationships. You will be responsible for visiting client properties, assessing their tree and shrub care needs, and providing scientific tree and shrub care recommendations.

**Benefits**
------------
